panels.title: Flow now
panels.description: Current flow rate per site (10s resolution).

panels.title: Last 7 days
panels.description: Water used in the last 7 days (rolling).

panels.title: vs previous 7 days
panels.description: Change in the last 7 days' usage compared with the 7 days before.

panels.title: House: flow rate
panels.description: Average flow rate (L/min). Dashed lines are the alert levels: 5 L/min for 60m, 10 L/min for 20m, 30 L/min for 5m.

panels.title: House: pump power
panels.description: Pump power draw. Dashed line: 200 W 'pump running' alert level. Pump running with no flow above = check flow sensor, prime, pipes.

panels.title: Farm: flow rate
panels.description: Average flow rate (L/min). Dashed lines are the alert levels: 5 L/min for 60m, 15 L/min for 30m, 30 L/min for 5m.

panels.title: Farm: pump power
panels.description: Pump power draw. Dashed line: 200 W 'pump running' alert level. Pump running with no flow above = check flow sensor, prime, pipes.

panels.title: Daily usage, last 14 days
panels.description: Litres per day, house and farm stacked. Prometheus days are UTC, so each bar is the 24h ending at 1pm NZDT (noon NZST).

panels.title: House: litres per hour, last 14 days
panels.description: Each row is the same 24 hours, N days earlier; each cell is one hour. Blank = no water; darker = more (classes: >0, 10, 50, 100, 250 L). Look down a column to compare a time of day across days (e.g. overnight usage = leak).

panels.title: Farm: litres per hour, last 14 days
panels.description: Each row is the same 24 hours, N days earlier; each cell is one hour. Blank = no water; darker = more (classes: >0, 10, 50, 100, 250 L). Look down a column to compare a time of day across days (e.g. overnight usage = leak).

panels.title: Flow meters
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status of each ESPHome flow meter.

targets.expr: (up{job="water"} * on (instance) group_left (flow) group by (instance, flow) (last_over_time(esphome_sensor_value{job="water",id="uptime"}[1d]))) or on (instance) up{job="water"}

panels.title: WiFi signal
panels.description: Signal strength at each flow meter. Below about -80 dBm, expect dropouts.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Restarts in the last 24h, uptime and the reason for the last restart.
